checks.title: ops docs cron schedule drifted from the role defaults it documents
checks.fix_rule: Edit only the docs table's schedule cell for the named cron to match the role default. Never edit the role defaults file from this check.
checks.pr_body: Updates the documented schedule for `{name}` in `{path}` to match the role default. Found by repo-crawl check D1.

checks.title: markdown page missing a required frontmatter key
checks.fix_rule: Add only the missing key(s) to the existing frontmatter block, with a value drawn from the page's own first heading or body. Never touch the page body, and never invent a fact not already on the page.
checks.pr_body: Adds the frontmatter key(s) this page was missing. Found by repo-crawl check D2.

checks.title: broken relative markdown link
checks.fix_rule: Fix only the one broken link target on the reported line (correct path, or remove the link if the target page was deleted). Never touch surrounding prose.
checks.pr_body: Fixes a broken relative link at `{path}:{line}`. Found by repo-crawl check D3.

checks.title: placeholder or TODO/FIXME text left in shipped docs
checks.fix_rule: Resolve the single flagged placeholder with real content sourced from the repo, or delete the line if it no longer applies. Never leave a new placeholder in its place.
checks.pr_body: Resolves a placeholder/TODO left in shipped docs at `{path}:{line}`. Found by repo-crawl check D4.

checks.title: doc claims a fact token that no longer exists in the code tree
checks.fix_rule: Remove or correct only the sentence naming the stale token; never restate the token's replacement from memory, only from a value actually found elsewhere in the repo.
checks.pr_body: Removes a doc claim about a token/name no longer present in the code tree, at `{path}:{line}`. Found by repo-crawl check D5.

checks.title: markdownlint finding
checks.fix_rule: Fix the reported rule violation for real in the offending line(s). Never add a markdownlint-disable comment, never loosen .markdownlint config, never widen an ignore glob.
checks.pr_body: Fixes a markdownlint finding at `{path}:{line}` in place. Found by repo-crawl check D6.

checks.title: skill frontmatter missing a required key
checks.fix_rule: Add only the missing frontmatter key(s). Never alter the skill's body or any other frontmatter field.
checks.pr_body: Adds the frontmatter key(s) this skill was missing. Found by repo-crawl check S1.

checks.title: shared-skill allowlist entry has no review record
checks.fix_rule: Report only. A missing review record is a human safety-review gap this check cannot fill in — never author a review record on a human's behalf.

checks.title: persona text and skill text contradict each other

rules.message: docs-pr claims GH_TOKEN is pre-provisioned while also describing how to mint one

checks.fix_rule: Report only. A persona/skill contradiction needs a human or a dedicated authoring change, not an automated one-file patch.

checks.title: stale .worktrees or .bak artifact
checks.fix_rule: Report only. Deleting a worktree can discard unpushed work; this check flags for a human to confirm before removal.
